context: Arkleia Oloril is the Flaming Fist quartermaster who runs the city armoury and is openly bitter about a newly imposed Steel Watch unit and its mechanical equipment being shoved into her remit. The racks hold Flaming Fist property and, amid recent crises driven by the Foundry, its Neurocitor control centre, and the Watchers, armoury supplies are effectively on strict hold — Arkleia is defensive and reluctant to sell or hand anything over. She uses the slur “istik” for outsiders and is short with anyone she sees as an intruder; the player can try persuasion, pressure, or influential name‑dropping (or threats) to overcome her duty‑bound resistance. Off‑screen, city tensions and factional orders explain why she insists items aren’t for trade, even when the player claims backing from powerful figures.
